Why SetuHashi

Understanding both sides. Connecting opportunity to action.

Japanese and Indian businesses can bring together capabilities, ambitions and market access to reach new customers, strengthen operations and create new business—in either country and beyond.

A promising connection is only the beginning. Businesses also need to understand one another, establish a workable commercial basis and organize what happens next.

SetuHashi brings together personal connections to India and Japan, experience developing businesses across markets, and the ability to help put plans into action. We work across both sides of an opportunity and bring in relevant capabilities as the work requires.

Our commitment is to help build business relationships that work in practice and create value for those involved.
